guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.1465 (z=+617) and latency-50 from 0.003 to 0.0591, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics fell and no other service shows a comparable shift. checkoutservice logs 160 'failed to send order confirmation ... no healthy upstream' errors, and emailservice logs 16 crash tracebacks ('non-dummy mode not implemented yet'), so the upstream is unhealthy; the latency spike best fits delay, though the tracebacks could also point to restarts.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect the emailservice deployment for the recent config change that set start(dummy_mode=False) and roll it back to dummy mode, or remove any injected network delay on emailservice. Then verify its pods are healthy and that checkoutservice order confirmations succeed.
